title: Audio Intake Detected Event
description: A pass over a finished transcription extracted ONE ticketable task from a recorded transcript and attributed it to a pjangler project. One event per ticketable task, emitted by the producer after bloodbank.audio.transcription.completed for the same transcription: same ordering_key bucket 'transcription:<transcription_id>', correlationid and causationid = the completion event id. This is an INTAKE, not a ticket fact: the pjangler project's PM triages it and creates the ticket (px task create), and bloodbank.repo.intake.triaged closes the loop by carrying the same data.intake_id. The Plane webhook echo is the ticket fact (bloodbank.repo.task.created); never mirror this event into a ticket. The pjangler project belongs in data.project_id; data.project is the producer's Candystore bucketing key and is NOT the ticket's project. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md section 7 (intake).

ordering_key.description: Section 11.1 bucket 'transcription:<transcription_id>', so the intakes order after the audio.transcription.completed event of the same job.

data.description: Payload for bloodbank.audio.intake.detected. One ticketable task.

project_id.description: pjangler project id (the registry slug / .project.json project_id). Lookup through the pjangler registry yields the ticket provider, board and PM. NOT the Plane identifier (e.g. HEYMA) and NOT a repo name.

description.description: Self-contained plain-text description of the ticketable task, written so a PM can create the ticket without opening the transcript.

transcript.description: FINAL transcript filename (basename, no directories) as it exists after title-slug renamed the note, e.g. 20261008-101411-ticketable-intake-events.md. Resolved by the producer at emit time, not at extraction time.

transcription_id.description: Same transcription_id as audio.transcription.completed (the Wax item id). Joins this intake to its source job.

intake_id.description: Stable id of this intake: '<transcription_id>:<12 lowercase hex of the ticket's content hash>'. Content-keyed, not index-based, so a re-run or re-plan that extracts the same ticket yields the same id. The PM copies it into bloodbank.repo.intake.triaged data.intake_id to close the loop.

index.description: 1-based position of this intake among the transcript's ticketable tasks.

count.description: Total ticketable tasks extracted from the transcript (index <= count).

title.description: Optional one-line ticket title for notifications and ticket creation. Null/absent means the consumer derives one from description.

project_name.description: Optional human-readable project name (registry project_name), for notification text only; project_id is the key.

transcript_uri.description: Optional canonical URI of the transcript note (file://, https://).

item_id.description: Producer-local item id; equal to transcription_id for Wax.

project.description: Producer bucketing key stamped on every Wax event for Candystore ('wax'). NOT the pjangler project; use project_id.
